output.answer: Samsung Electronics' most recent full-year revenue was KRW 333.6 trillion (about US$233 billion at the exchange rate implied in contemporaneous reporting) for fiscal year 2025, ended December 31, 2025 — up 10.9% from 2024. The company reported this on January 29, 2026 alongside record fourth-quarter results (Q4 2025 revenue of KRW 93.8 trillion, FY2025 operating profit of KRW 43.6 trillion). FY2026 full-year revenue is not yet available; with Q3 2026 revenue alone at KRW 195.3 trillion, the full-year 2026 figure (due late January 2027) will far exceed the FY2025 number, so 333.6 trillion won will soon be superseded.
